text_en: Moses convened all Israel, and said to them: Hear, O Israel, the statutes and ordinances that I am addressing to you today; you shall learn them and observe them diligently.
text_cn: 梅瑟召集了全以色列人，对他们说：“请听我今日向你们耳中所宣示的法令和规则，务要学习遵行。

text_en: The Lord our God made a covenant with us at Horeb.
text_cn: 上主我们的天主在曷勒布与我们立了约。

text_en: Not with our ancestors did the Lord make this covenant, but with us, who are all of us here alive today.
text_cn: 上主并不是与我们的祖先立了这约，而是与我们今日在这里尚生存的众人。

text_en: The Lord spoke with you face to face at the mountain, out of the fire.
text_cn: 上主在山上，从火中面对面地与你们谈过话。

text_en: (At that time I was standing between the Lord and you to declare to you the words of the Lord ; for you were afraid because of the fire and did not go up the mountain. ) And he said:
text_cn: 那时我站在上主和你们中间，给你们传达上主的话，因为你们一见火便害了怕，没有上到山上去。上主说：

text_en: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery;
text_cn: “我是上主，你的天主，我曾领你离开埃及地，那为奴之家，

text_en: you shall have no other gods before me.
text_cn: 除我以外，你不可有别的神。

text_en: You shall not make for yourself an idol, whether in the form of anything that is in heaven above, or that is on the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth.
text_cn: 你不可为自己雕刻偶像，或制造任何上天下地，或地下水中所有各物的形像。

text_en: You shall not bow down to them or worship them; for I the Lord your God am a jealous God, punishing children for the iniquity of parents, to the third and fourth generation of those who reject me,
text_cn: 你不可叩拜，也不可事奉这样的偶像，因为我上主，你的天主是忌邪的天主。对于恨我的人，我必在子孙身上追罚他们祖先的罪恶，直到第三代，第四代；

text_en: but showing steadfast love to the thousandth generation of those who love me and keep my commandments.
text_cn: 对于爱我，守我诫命的人，我对他们施行仁慈，直到千代。

text_en: You shall not make wrongful use of the name of the Lord your God, for the Lord will not acquit anyone who misuses his name.
text_cn: 你不可妄呼上主，你天主的名，因为上主决不放过妄呼他名的人。

text_en: Observe the sabbath day and keep it holy, as the Lord your God commanded you.
text_cn: 当照上主，你的天主吩咐的，遵守安息日，奉为圣日。

text_en: Six days you shall labor and do all your work.
text_cn: 六天你当劳作，做你一切工作；

text_en: But the seventh day is a sabbath to the Lord your God; you shall not do any work—you, or your son or your daughter, or your male or female slave, or your ox or your donkey, or any of your livestock, or the resident alien in your towns, so that your male and female slave may rest as well as you.
text_cn: 第七天是上主你天主的安息日，你和你的子女、仆婢、牛驴、你所有的牲畜，以及住在你城内的外方人，都不应做任何工作，好使你的仆婢能如你一样获得安息。

text_en: Remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and the Lord your God brought you out from there with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm; therefore the Lord your God commanded you to keep the sabbath day.
text_cn: 你应记得：你在埃及地也曾做过奴隶，上主你的天主以大能的手和伸展的臂，将你从那里领出来；为此，上主你的天主吩咐你守安息日。

text_en: Honor your father and your mother, as the Lord your God commanded you, so that your days may be long and that it may go well with you in the land that the Lord your God is giving you.
text_cn: 应照上主你的天主吩咐你的，孝敬你的父母，好使你能享高寿，并在上主你的天主赐给你的土地内，获享幸福。

text_en: You shall not murder.
text_cn: 不可杀人。

text_en: Neither shall you commit adultery.
text_cn: 不可奸淫。

text_en: Neither shall you steal.
text_cn: 不可偷盗。

text_en: Neither shall you bear false witness against your neighbor.
text_cn: 不可作假见证害你的近人。

text_en: Neither shall you covet your neighbor’s wife. Neither shall you desire your neighbor’s house, or field, or male or female slave, or ox, or donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor.
text_cn: 不可贪恋你近人的妻子；不可贪图你近人的房屋、田地、仆婢、牛驴，以及属于你近人的一切事物。”

text_en: These words the Lord spoke with a loud voice to your whole assembly at the mountain, out of the fire, the cloud, and the thick darkness, and he added no more. He wrote them on two stone tablets, and gave them to me.
text_cn: 这是上主在山上，由火中，由浓云黑暗里，大声对你们会众所说的话，再没有加添什么；并将这些话写在两块石版上，交给了我。

text_en: When you heard the voice out of the darkness, while the mountain was burning with fire, you approached me, all the heads of your tribes and your elders;
text_cn: 当山上火焰四射，你们听到由黑暗中发出来的声音时，你们各支派的首领和长老，都来到我跟前，

text_en: and you said, “Look, the Lord our God has shown us his glory and greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the fire. Today we have seen that God may speak to someone and the person may still live.
text_cn: 说：“看，上主我们的天主，使我们看见了他的荣耀和伟大，我们也听见了他由火中发出的声音；今日我们见了天主与人说话，而人还能生存！

text_en: So now why should we die? For this great fire will consume us; if we hear the voice of the Lord our God any longer, we shall die.
text_cn: 现在，我们为什么要冒死，为这大火所吞灭？如果我们继续听上主我们天主的声音，我们必死无疑。

text_en: For who is there of all flesh that has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of fire, as we have, and remained alive?
text_cn: 因为凡有血肉的人，有谁如我们一样，听到永生的天主由火中说话的声音，而仍能生存呢？

text_en: Go near, you yourself, and hear all that the Lord our God will say. Then tell us everything that the Lord our God tells you, and we will listen and do it. ”
text_cn: 请你近前去，聆听上主我们的天主所说的一切；然后你将上主我们的天主对你所说的话，转告给我们；我们必听从，也必遵行。”

text_en: The Lord heard your words when you spoke to me, and the Lord said to me: “I have heard the words of this people, which they have spoken to you; they are right in all that they have spoken.
text_cn: 你们对我所说的话，上主听见了；遂对我说：“我听见了这人民对你所说的话；他们所说的都对。

text_en: If only they had such a mind as this, to fear me and to keep all my commandments always, so that it might go well with them and with their children forever!
text_cn: 惟愿他们常存这样的心思，敬畏我，遵守我的一切诫命，好使他们和他们的子孙永享幸福。

text_en: Go say to them, ‘Return to your tents. ’
text_cn: 你去对他们说：你们回到你们的帐幕内去。

text_en: But you, stand here by me, and I will tell you all the commandments, the statutes and the ordinances, that you shall teach them, so that they may do them in the land that I am giving them to possess. ”
text_cn: 但是，你应留在我这里，我要将一切诫命、法令和规则训示你，你再教训他们，好叫他们在我赐给他们作为产业的地上遵行。”

text_en: You must therefore be careful to do as the Lord your God has commanded you; you shall not turn to the right or to the left.
text_cn: 所以你们应完全遵照上主你们的天主所吩咐你们的行事，不可偏右偏左。

text_en: You must follow exactly the path that the Lord your God has commanded you, so that you may live, and that it may go well with you, and that you may live long in the land that you are to possess.
text_cn: 在一切事上，只应履行上主你们的天主给你们指定的道路，好使你们在你们要去占领的地方，得以生存、兴盛、长寿。
